data_quality.transcripts: Full raw transcripts were not obtained for any call. Quotes were returned through summarisers: [V*] means near-verbatim, [P] means paraphrase. Basis (standalone/consolidated) is not stated in most digests.
data_quality.recompute: Weights re-based to 7 graded events (Q4 FY26 = 7 ... Q2 FY25 = 1). Q1 FY27 is pending and excluded. Sum of weighted grades 30.617 / 28 x 5 = 5.47.
data_quality.repeat_rule: Repeated promises are graded once, at the first date-specific statement. Later re-dates are folded into the note. Origins before Q2 FY25 were not traced, so outside_window entries are not added.
data_quality.conflicts: EBITDA margin sources conflict. Q4 FY26: 17.3% (Arihant) vs 18.47% (ScanX). Q1 FY27: 23.25% (press release) vs 17.3% or 21.6% (other sources). FY26: 15.4% vs 16.70%. Grades that depend on margins are marked low-confidence.
data_quality.not_checked: Q2 FY27 results not out as of 2026-09-18 (last check). Reasons for the revisions (25-30% to 20%, capacity slips, PLI withdrawal) were not found in the digests, so those grades stay 0. Re-verify every 0 and 1 against the raw transcripts.
